anna_sales: Heads up 1: Acme Financial wants a 3-week air-gapped POC. Requirements: sealed bundle delivery (no internet), monthly security deltas, quarterly model refresh, and an activation runbook for their NOC. Asking for cost estimate for offline support.
tom_se: Quick q: full air-gapped (zero egress) or allowed egress to a customer proxy?
client_it: full air-gapped. We'll receive signed media via secure courier. No outbound from cluster.
maria_ops: OK. For fully sealed we'll provide: signed minibundles (deterministic tar + sha256), installer image with pinned root CA, an offline activation token flow (time-limited), and a cert rotation procedure (we recommend 9-12 months). Initial transfer size depends on model choice.
tom_se: typical sizes: tiny quantized runtime ~2.8GB, med ~7GB, large ~22GB. With runtime + base model + deps expect 1035GB one-time. Deltas after that usually <150MB.
anna_sales: they asked if monthly deltas via USB are feasible and what validation we do before release.
maria_ops: monthly deltas are fine. Ops will sign and run a smoke validation matrix (expected 2448h). We require customer's acceptance window. If they want automated weekly deltas we need a paid accelerated validation SLA.
client_it: can you support customer HSM for key wrapping? We cannot send private keys.
tom_se: we support HSM/KMS integrations in Private. Offline envelope wrapping works but requires an exchange of public signing keys and an attestation step prior to courier. We'll supply the signing manifest and verify signatures on install.
deploy-bot: build:airgap-bundle: 1767000007 completed (sha256: def456...).
anna_sales: pricing ask: 1) one-time bundling/signing 2) per-delta validation 3) courier coordination. Maria, rough numbers?
maria_ops: internal ballpark: bundling + signing $3,500 one-time; per-delta validation $600; courier coordination (domestic) ~$400, international up to $1,800. Onsite activation support billed separately at daily rate. All estimates subject to SOW.
tom_se: I'll draft an 8-step activation runbook for their NOC (preflight, verify sha256 & signature, install, run health checks, init cache, cert-rotation test, smoke traffic, fallback to previous bundle). Posting tomorrow.
client_it: please include rollback steps and contact escalation matrix. We'll provide public signing key and target courier window next week.
anna_sales: next actions: tom draft runbook, maria confirm signing process details and attach the exact manifest example, anna will send the security questionnaire draft with our answers and the price ballpark. Reopen if anything else. :white_check_mark:
